what_this_is: What the machines are doing right now. Each count is read from the file that job writes as it works, not typed in by hand. Nothing here is a result. Results go to the data page when the job that produced them finishes.

jobs.title: Does a structure help when almost nothing has been measured
jobs.note: 32 further proteins were declined, because their measured compounds do not spread across enough distinct chemistry to split into a held-out set. The registration asks for 25 or as many as exist.
jobs.why_it_matters: This is the claim the product rests on. If a model trained only on known actives wins here, the claim is withdrawn.
jobs.link_text: the registration, written before any result

jobs.title: Searching every protein in ChEMBL for ones nobody has measured
jobs.note: 53 qualify so far. A protein qualifies with 15 to 45 measured compounds and 150 to 420 residues, which is few enough that a model trained on known actives has almost nothing to learn from.
jobs.why_it_matters: The experiment above cannot finish until this finds enough proteins, so this is the thing holding it up.

jobs.title: Rescoring every published protein under the corrected pipeline
jobs.note: Every figure on this site was computed before two defects were fixed. This recomputes all of them to find out whether the published numbers move. Whatever it returns goes on the site, including if it goes against us.
jobs.why_it_matters: If the headline moves, the headline changes and the old one stays in the corrections record.
